name: 談話マーカー分析
description: 分析します the usage パターン of 談話標識 (connectives, transitions) to differentiate AI生成の from 人間が書いた text.
useCase: 結束的な談話接続詞の過度の使用または不足によるAIテキストの検出
mechanism: 識別します and quantifies 談話標識 (e.g., 'however', 'therefore', 'furthermore', 'in addition') and their positional 分布 内の texts. AI生成の text typically exhibits a narrower set of 談話標識 with more formulaic placement パターン. The method constructs a discourse marker profile and compares it against human reference 分布s using Jensen-Shannon divergence.
accuracy: 中 - 73-83% 精度 にわたる domains
source: Kumarage et al. (2023) - Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines, arXiv
algorithm: Discourse Marker Extraction + Positional Analysis + Distribution Comparison
parameters: Marker lexicon: 150+ markers, Position tracking: sentence-initial/medial/final, Frequency normalization: per-sentence, Comparison: JSD metric
strengths:
• Captures high-level text organization パターン
• Robust にわたる different text lengths
• Linguistically interpretable 特徴
• Complements token-level 検出 methods
limitations:
• Marker inventory varies にわたる languages
• Genre-dependent baseline 分布s
• Advanced LLMs can produce varied discourse パターン
• Requires careful marker taxonomy definition

references.title: Kumarage, T. et al. (2023). Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines. arXiv.
